changeSet.comment: Idempotent seed from existing silver Parquet (2405 rows) -> dim. No OR REPLACE (two UNIQUE keys need conflict target).
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dim.dim_instrument (instrument_id, symbol, asset_class, exchange_id, currency, sector, lot_size, _source, _ingest_ts, is_current) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(instrument_id),0) FROM dim.dim_instrument) + row_number() OVER (ORDER BY symbol) AS instrument_id, symbol, CASE WHEN symbol LIKE '^%' THEN 'INDEX' ELSE 'EQUITY' END, 1, 'USD', 'UNKNOWN', 1, 'yahoo', now(), true FROM (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM read_parquet('/media/sandeep/DataDrive2/hedge-fund/datalake/data/silver/market/ohlcv.parquet')) WHERE symbol NOT IN (SELECT symbol FROM dim.dim_instrument)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dim.dim_equity (instrument_id) SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_instrument WHERE asset_class='EQUITY' AND instrument_id NOT IN (SELECT instrument_id FROM dim.dim_equity)

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM dim.dim_equity WHERE instrument_id > 0; DELETE FROM dim.dim_instrument WHERE instrument_id > 0
